scripts.dev: npm run build -w @relay/shared && npm run build -w @relay/api && node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -n api:types,api,web -c blue,yellow,green "npm run dev:types -w @relay/api" "npm run dev:server -w @relay/api" "npm run dev -w @relay/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @relay/shared && npm run build -w @relay/api && npm run build -w @relay/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @relay/shared && npm run build -w @relay/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @relay/shared && npm run build -w @relay/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @relay/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @relay/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
